prompt: Lua file:read "n" numeral format maximum input length
answer:
In Lua 5.3–5.5, `file:read("n")` accepts numerals up to **200 characters by default**, controlled by the compile-time macro `L_MAXLENNUM`:

```c
#define L_MAXLENNUM 200
```

This limit can be changed when compiling Lua.
